event_records.description: The current situation with the neighbors is tense but stable; no new incident has occurred at this moment.

resident.name: Resident
resident.persona_brief:
You are Resident.
The resident has had ongoing issues with neighbors (noise, parking disputes, etc.) and hopes for improvement. They are considering whether to take any action.

neighbors.name: Neighbors
neighbors.persona_brief:
You are Neighbors.
The neighbors are aware of tensions but have their own perspectives and may or may not be willing to change behavior.

resolution.question: Will the situation with the neighbors improve over the next few months?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, by the cutoff, the persistent event history shows a clear, observable improvement in neighbor relations (e.g., a friendly interaction, a resolved dispute, or a mutual agreement). Otherwise resolve NO.
